description:
South East London's leading arts centre,.
The Albany is the engine room for people to reach their creative potential, tell their stories and define their own culture. Together we will inspire new possibilities for positive change.  
The Albany is an incubator for new ideas and initiatives. Our Creative Strategy places democratic, community-led approaches at the heart of everything we do,

factsheet.heading: South East London's leading arts centre
paragraphs: South East London's leading arts centre, in the heart of Deptford.
Our buildings are the beating heart of Deptford – with four performance spaces, a café, garden and incredible artists and organisations who have chosen to make us their home.
Hidden away behind our building, the Albany garden is an urban oasis. It’s a space for food growing, a home for wildlife and a chance to step away from our busy lives and reconnect with nature.
